senses.gloss: f.(b. h. נְעֹרֶת; נָער) [light matter,] scraps, chips.
units: Y. Sabb. IV, 6ᵈ bot., v. נְסוֹרֶת.—Esp. נ׳ (של פשתן) hatcheled flax.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 4:1">Sabb. IV, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 49a:10">49ᵃ</cite>) <he>נ׳ של פ׳ דקה</he> thoroughly beaten flax (cmp. <cite ref="D01022"><he>דַקְתָּא</he></cite>). Ib. 11ᵃ, a. e., v. <cite ref="A03254"><he>אֵשׁ</he></cite>.
